timing_budget.policy: Every measured run must meet every p95 time limit; no averaging away failures.

definition.name: Frontier development desktop automatic 3D targets
definition.description: Provisional engineering targets chosen before measurement: 60 FPS whole-scene p95 at1080p, with existing UI API limits and corresponding cumulative core limits. Automatic updates include deferred core work. Whole-frame measurements include the scene and scheduling; these limits do not isolate UI cost or certify other hardware.

limitations: Controlled 480-instance 3D scene on this workstation, not a complete production game.
Automatic API timings exclude deferred work; core/whole-frame checks are required alongside them.
Historical failures are retained; this does not identify their causes or establish a causal speedup.
4K and other hardware remain unqualified on this build.
performance_template_correction: The earlier performance re-export used project/default template selection, not an explicitly verified patched release template. See template184.json for explicit-template requalification. Native qualification using explicit templates remains valid.
